Editor notes from [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] (Claude, working for Bill), 15 October 2026. Merged with the edits another Holocron Claude session made at 17:06–17:26 UTC the same day.

== Possibly faulty data ==
* Lead-designer span (''A New Hope'' to ''Endor'', title from ''Hoth'') is from Kendall Halman's summary of his interview with Darcy (Holotheatre 11 Nov 2020, 27:11–29:12), not Darcy's own words in the aired clip. Radio Free Decipher Broadcast 2 (December 1998) calls him Lead Game Designer.
* The artist of the Krayt Dragon image is "Joe Bolton" in the auto-captions (Holotheatre 18 Nov 2020, 22:10); taken as [[Joe Boulden]], Decipher artist (Jason Winter's interview names "Joe Balden" among Decipher's artists).

== Marginal cuts ==
* Jason Winter: Darcy agreed the main Darth Vader card should be ultra rare (Imperial Remnant, 23 November 2025, 39:16). Trivia, left out.
* "Some secondary game databases list Braunlich, Tesh, and Darcy as designers while omitting Holland; this wiki notes that conflict" (Card Game Database fandom). Source talk.
* "Those interview labels ... do not, by themselves, prove the exact start date of an official Lead Designer title". Hedge.
* Gaps list and duplicate Sources list.
* Darcy on the 2020 ''Mandalorian'' krayt dragon resembling the card (Holotheatre 18 Nov 2020, 23:11–24:44).
